selection: At most 25 candidates per window on training net cost-stress (0.2%) results, sorted by lower trade time underwater then effective net PnL; freeze exact configuration, Block count and window before validation.
validation: No retuning. Same frozen lane must have at least 42 closes, positive effective net PnL, effective realized PF >=1.1 or positive profit without losses, recent-window admission and max time underwater <=300min at both costs over all 14 days and each of two seven-day halves; every half at least 12 closes. Compare shared production defaults on same data. No global default promotion from a sole-symbol profile; only a supported SOL-scoped default if robust, otherwise preserve defaults and publish rejections.
limitations: Historical OHLC cannot validate venue fills; dynamic loss/recovery Block stages require separate lifecycle tests. Previous diagnostic period is not independent.
outcome: No training candidate satisfied cost stress plus at least 42 closes. No frozen candidate reached validation, no defaults changed; reserved holdout has no performance result.
